import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
A,B=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
print("demo2: 9-anchor cells:",[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if A[i][j]==9])
# Which bg cells became 9? list with their coordinates relative to anchors
to9=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if A[i][j]==7 and B[i][j]==9]
for p in to9:
    # nearest 9-anchor distance (Chebyshev)
    d9=min(max(abs(p[0]-a[0]),abs(p[1]-a[1])) for a in [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if A[i][j]==9])
    print(p,'cheb dist to nearest 9:',d9)

from collections import Counter as Ct
import os,glob,re
base='/home/USER/runs/rt/dagger-u4-scratch/frozen/seen-2/play/users/u037/system/state/sessions/'
def load():
    G={}
    for f in glob.glob(base+'*.jsonl'):
        t=open(f,errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
        if '61991f33' not in t: continue
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); pairs={i:(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'],G[f'Demo pair {i} output']) for i in range(1,9)}
# Hypothesis: bg cell gets value of NEAREST accent (Manhattan or Chebyshev); bg with no accent in sight -> 2
def solve(g, met):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bb=Ct(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    acc=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bb]
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bb: row.append(g[r][c]); continue
            if not acc: row.append(2); continue
            best=min(acc,key=lambda p:(met(abs(p[0]-r),abs(p[1]-c)),p[0]*p[1]))
            # prefer smaller manhattan, then ... try: min dman then mindist
            dm=(lambda r_,c_: abs(r_)+abs(c_))(best[0],best[1])
            dc=(lambda r_,c_: max(abs(r_-r),abs(c_-c)))(best[0],best[1])
            ds=[(max(abs(a-r),abs(b-c)),abs(a-r)+abs(b-c),a,b) for a,b,vv in acc]
            m=min(d for d,_,_ in ds); ms=[t for t,dd,mm in ds if dd<=m]
            vals={t[2] for t in ms}
            # tie break: closer in cheby first; tie -> ? pick by count? try any
            row.append(next(iter(vals)))
        out.append(row)
    return out
